digest.component_or_area: fsck snapshot rebuild and event compaction
propositions: fsck snapshot rebuild silently drops history that exists only in prior snapshots when source events were deleted during pre-Jul-7 compaction, causing 214 tickets to revert from closed status (480 events lost including 219 STATUS, 181 SIGNATURE, 64 COMMENT)

rebuild_snapshot_from_full_log fails to detect incomplete logs caused by legacy event deletion and replays only surviving files, allowing order-sensitive events like STATUS to be reconstructed incorrectly from the newest surviving claim rather than the complete history
--repair-snapshots path ignores dry_run parameter and mutates the store, while --repair path honors it, preventing read-only preview of the broad rebuild operation

rebuild_snapshot_from_full_log must refuse to rebuild when prior snapshot cites source_event_uuids with no corresponding file on disk, surfacing for human triage instead of silently writing lossy snapshots
fsck must restore deleted source events from origin/tickets history (504/505 tickets have complete deletion records) and retry rebuild after restoration to make the log complete and repair-able
latent population of 505 live tickets have snapshots citing missing source events and remain vulnerable to the same silent corruption until restored
